components_tested_separately.note: SAGE-style corpus metadata/keyword augmentation. Not novel by itself.
Title/author/citation-field aware retrieval when the task permits it.
Query diversification with existing content-identity dedup. Not novel by itself.
Retrieval-route selection based on observed marginal unique-relevant gain. Deferred until the discriminator isolates whether route allocation, rather than query generation, is the loss.

official_implementations.rule: If an official implementation cannot run, mark CANNOT_CHECK. Do not weaken the baseline.

safety_floor: no increase in premature closure beyond a frozen safety margin
why_now: Deep official scoring (PR #266) has hit rate 0.000 with a passing judge control and exact/substring title recovery 0/564 from frozen candidates. The earliest failing stage is candidate generation. A novel adaptive allocator is not licensed until a matched Wide run, or this discriminator, says what is broken in query/candidate generation.
